question: Which of the following dances of South India is known as peacock dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mayilattam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Mayilattam** is a folk dance from Tamil Nadu, South India, also known as the peacock dance.
 
• In this dance, the performers dress up as peacocks, and it is characterized by its vibrant costumes and elaborate makeup.
 
• The dancers wear a peacock headgear and a beak, and their costumes include eye-catching feathers that mimic the appearance of a peacock.
 
• Mayilattam is traditionally performed during temple festivals and special occasions to entertain and seek blessings from the deities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Garadi**

 
 
• Garadi is a traditional folk dance of the Puducherry region in South India.
 
• It is performed during festivals and special occasions, featuring dancers dressed in vibrant costumes.
 
• The dance is accompanied by traditional music and instruments such as drums and cymbals.
 
 
 
• **Padayani**
 
 
• Padayani is a ritual dance performed in Kerala, South India.
 
• It is associated with the worship of goddess Bhadrakali and is performed in temple festivals.
 
• The dancers wear elaborate masks and costumes, and the dance depicts mythological stories and legends.
 
 
 
• **Kummi**
 
 
• Kummi is a traditional folk dance of Tamil Nadu, South India.
 
• It is usually performed by women during festivals and social gatherings.
 
• The dance involves rhythmic clapping and steps, and it is often accompanied by folk songs.
